name: Niendorf an der Stecknitz (Germany)
description: Five horizontal stripes of blue, white, red, white and blue, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Niendorf an der Stecknitz (crossed swords beneath a monogram on red).
history: Municipal flag of Niendorf a. d. St.; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Niendorf arms — crossed swords and monogram on red
